text.body: nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīyopaniṣat prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ atha brahmāṇaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanatkumāraḥ papraccha | kīdṛśaṃ nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣaraṃ bhavatīti vyācaṣṭe | atha yo vai nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān parabrahmaṇa ānando bhavati | jñātvā jīvanmukto bhavati | saccidānandasvarūpaparavastu bhavati | aṣṭākṣaraṃ aṣṭamūrti bhavati | prathamarūpaḥ pṛthivīrūpo bhavati | dvitīyamāpo bhavati | tṛtīyastejo bhavati | caturtho vāyurbhavati | pañcama ākāśo bhavati | ṣaṣṭhaścandramā bhavati | saptamaḥ sūryo bhavati | aṣṭamo yajamānaḥ || bhūmirāpastathā tejo vāyurvyoma ca candramāḥ | sūryaḥ pumāṃstathā ceti mūrtayaścāṣṭa kīrtitāḥ || akārokāramakāranādabindukalānusandhānadhyānāṣṭavidhā aṣṭākṣaraṃ bhavati | akāraḥ sadyojāto bhavati | ukāro vāmadevaḥ | aghoro makāro bhavati | tatpuruṣo nādaḥ | bindurīśānaḥ | kalā vyāpako bhavati | anusandhāno nityaḥ | dhyānasvarūpaṃ brahma | sarvavyāpako'ṣṭākṣaraḥ || nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma jñānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ mahāpuruṣaṃ viśvamātmānamavyayam || antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ sthito nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | sahasraśīrṣaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam || nārāyaṇaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ sarvavedāntagocaram | sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāratirodhānānusaṃmatam | pañcakṛtyasya kartāraṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣaramantraṃ vyācaṣṭe | śrīmannārāyaṇasya daśamantrāḥ kathyante | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ityaṣṭākṣaro mantraḥ | sa eva mantrarājo bhavati | etannārāyaṇasya tārakaṃ bhavati | tadevopāsitavyaṃ bhavati | ityuvāca bhagavānnārāyaṇaśabdaparabrahmaśrīmahāmāyāprakṛtisarvamekajananīlakṣmīrbhavati | devānāṃ devalakṣmīrbhavati | siddhānāṃ siddhalakṣmīrbhavati | mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣalakṣmīrbhavati | yogināṃ yogalakṣmīrbhavati | munīnāṃ vivekabuddhirbhavati | rājñāṃ rājyalakṣmīrbhavati | sṛṣṭirūpā sarasvatī bhavati | sthitirūpā mahālakṣmīrbhavati | saṃhārarūpā rudrāṇī bhavati | tirodhānakarī pārvatī bhavati | anugraharūpā umā bhavati | pañcakṛtyarūpā parameśvarī bhavati | śrīmahālakṣmyai nama iti saptākṣaro mantraḥ || sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ mahāsaubhāgyadāyinī | mahālakṣmīrmahādevī sarvalokaikamohinī || sāmrājyadāyinī nityaṃ sarvavedasvarūpiṇī | mahāvidyā jaganmātā munīnāṃ mokṣadāyinī | jñānināṃ jñānadā satyaṃ dānavānāṃ vināśinī || iti mahālakṣmīrmūlaprakṛtirbhavati | nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān parabrahmasvarūpī sarvavedāntagocaraḥ nityaśuddhabuddhaparabrahmānandamayo bhavati | tasmāllakṣmīnārāyaṇa iti sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇamantraḥ kīdṛśo bhavati | " oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt " iti gāyatrī bhavati | " idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam | samūḍhamasya pāṃsure|", " ato devā bhavantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame | pṛthivyāḥ saptadhāmabhiḥ" iti mantradvayena nārāyaṇapratipāditaṃ bhavati | "sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sa hariḥ sendraḥ so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ" | nārāyaṇāyeti pañcākṣaraṃ bhavati | oṃ namo viṣṇava iti ṣaḍakṣaraṃ vijñātam | namo nārāyaṇāyeti saptākṣaraṃ bhavati | oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti dvādaśaṃ parikīrtitam | oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namo nārāyaṇāya svāhā | yasya kasyāpi na deyam | putro deyaḥ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī | na vadedyasya kasyāpi kiṃ tu śiṣyāya tāṃ vadet || oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavate lakṣmīnārāyaṇāya viṣṇave vāsudevāya svāhā || śrīmahāviṣṇave tubhyaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca | govindāya ca rudrāya haraye brahmarūpiṇe || nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo śrīdharānanta keśava | vāsudeva jagannātha hṛṣīkeśa namo namaḥ || ityanuṣṭubdvayaṃ mantraṃ vyākhyātam | atha mālāmantraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān pitāmahaḥ gāyatrīṃ vyācaṣṭe | govindāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi | tanno nārāyaṇaḥ pracodayāt | kāmadevāya vidmahe puṣpabāṇāya dhīmahi | tanno'naṅgaḥ pracodayāt | mahādevyai ca vidmahe viṣṇupatnī ca dhīmahi | tanno lakṣmīḥ pracodayāt | " viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi pravocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi| yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ", " trirdevaḥ pṛthivīmeṣa etām | vicakrame śatarcasaṃ mahitvā | praviṣṇurastu tavasastavīyān | tveṣaṃ hyasya sthavirasya nāma |" saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakṛta | atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhivāci || "pratadviṣṇustavate vīryāya | mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣu | adhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā |", "ya īṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti | na hi praveda sukṛtasya panthām |" akṣanvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo mano jīveṣvasamā babhūvuḥ | tasmālakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sarvabījaṃ sarvabhūtādhivāsaṃ yo vetti sa vidvān bhavati | upāsakānāṃ mokṣaprāptirbhavati | sa jīvanmukto bhavati | sa hovāca bhagavān upāsanavidhiṃ vyācaṣṭe | brahmā ṛṣirbhavati | gāyatrī chanda ucyate | śrīmannārāyaṇaparamātmā devatā | praṇavaṃ bījam | namaḥ śaktirucyate | kīlakaṃ nārāyaṇeti || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogo'tha bhāvanā | maholkāya vīrolkāya vṛddholkāya pṛthūlkāya vidyulkāya jvaladulkāya ca ṣaḍaṅgakalpitāḥ namaḥsvāhāvaṣaḍvauṣaṭpadāntā aṅganyāsā bhavanti | nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam | kirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ kaustubhodbhāsitorasam || śaṅkhacakragadākhaṅgadhāriṇaṃ vanamālinam | vāmabhāge mahālakṣmyāliṅgitārdhaśarīriṇam || sanakādibhiḥ saṃsevyaṃ stūyamānaṃ maharṣibhiḥ | brahmādibhiḥ sadā dhyeyaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum || karmaṇā manasā vācā saṃsmaret prajapet sudhīḥ | ayutaṃ japamātreṇa sarvajñānaprado bhavet || lakṣamātraṃ tu prajapet svasvarūpaṃ bhavenmanuḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ sadā dhyāyet sākṣānnārāyaṇo hariḥ || sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā daśakalātmako'vatāraḥ kathyate || jarā pālinikā śāntirīśvarī ratikāmikā | varadā hlādinī prītirdīrghā daśakalā hareḥ || nārāyaṇādavatārā mantrarūpā jāyante | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya svāhā | evaṃ daśākṣaro mahāmantro bhavati | tatra prathamo matsyāvatāraḥ | dvitīyaḥ kūrmaḥ | tṛtīyo varāhaḥ | caturtho narasihmaḥ | pañcamo vāmanaḥ | ṣaṣṭho jamadagniḥ | saptamo rāmacandraḥ | aṣṭamaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā | navamo buddhāvatāraḥ | daśamaḥ kalkirjanārdanaḥ | oṃ matsyāvatārāya namaḥ | śrī kūrmāvatārāya namaḥ | hrīṃ varāhāvatārāya namaḥ | huṃ nṛsiṃhāvatārāya namaḥ | sauḥ vāmanāvatārāya namaḥ | aiṃ paraśurāmāvatārāya namaḥ | glauṃ rāmacandrāya namaḥ | klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ | blūṃ buddhāvatārāya namaḥ | saḥ kalkyavatārāya namaḥ iti | prajāpatiḥ prajāyate | tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ prajāyate | brahmā jāyate | brahmaṇaḥsakāśāt pañcamahābhūtāni tanmātrāṇi jāyante | jñānendriyakarmendriyāṇi manobuddhicittāhaṃkārā jāyante | prakṛtirjāyate | caturviṃśatitattvātmako nārāyaṇaḥ | pañcaviṃśatitattvātmakaḥ puruṣatvaṃ parabrahma bhavet | śivaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | śakraśca nārāyaṇaḥ | diśaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | ūrdhvañca nārāyaṇaḥ | antaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma | tasmānnārāyaṇādaṇḍajasvedajodbhijjajarāyujamanasijādayaḥ sarve mahābhūtāḥ prajāyante || ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīṃ prajāṃ janayantīṃ sarūpām | ajo hyeko juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajo'nyaḥ || aṇḍajāḥ sarvakhagarūpā jāyante | svedajāḥ krimikīṭādayaḥ | udbhijjāstarugulmalatādayaḥ | jarāyujā narapaśumṛgādayo jāyante | manasijā nāradādayaḥ sarve ṛṣayaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmako bhavati | aṣṭavasavo nārāyaṇaḥ | ekādaśarudrā nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇāt dvādaśādityāḥ | sarve devā ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhagandharvayakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāḥ sarve nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇa evedaṃ sarvam | lakṣmīrmūlaprakṛtiriti vijñāyate | vastvekaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇaḥ sanātanaḥ || sākṣānnārāyaṇo devaḥ parabrahmābhidhīyate | saccidānandātmakāḥ syurviṣṇau nitye prakalpitāḥ | nānāvidhāni rūpāṇi hāṭake kaṭakādivat || " catvāri vākparimitā padāni | tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ | guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti | turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti |" parāpaśyantīmadhyamāvaikharīrūpā sarasvatīti caturvidhā vāco vadanti | vaikharī sarvavidyāsu praśastā || aṅgāni vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ | purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca vidyā hyetāścaturdaśa || āyurvedo dhanurvedo gāndharvaṃ mantraśāstrakam | vidyāścāṣṭādaśa proktā nārāyaṇaniveśitāḥ || tasya niśvasitameva ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvāṅgiraśceti | sarvavedavedāntānāṃ nārāyaṇaparabrahmaṇyeva tātparyam | sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇayantramantrāvaraṇapūjāmācacakṣe | trikoṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavati | dvitīyaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhavati | vṛttamaṣṭadalaṃ tṛtīyam | caturtha dvādaśadalam | pañcamaṃ ṣoḍaśadalam | caturviṃśati[ḥ]ṣaṣṭham | dvātriṃśati[ḥ] saptamam | aṣṭamaṃ bhūpuram | evaṃ yantraṃ samālikhet | madhye lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vikṣepaśaktyāvaraṇaṃ śaktiprabhāśaktitrikoṇadevatāḥ ṣaṭakoṇaṃ vṛddholkādayaḥ pūjyāḥ | sarvajñānitvatṛptyanādibodhasvatantranityamaluptānantaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaśaktayaḥ | sanakasanandanasanatsujātasanatkumārasanātananāradatumburusamantādayo'ṣṭadalāḥ | vasiṣṭhavālakhilyaviśvāmitrakaśyapātribharadvājāṅgīrasajāmadagnigautamāgastyajā bālikapilā dvādaśadalāḥ | matsyakūrmavarāhanārasiṃhavāmanarāmarāmakṛṣṇabuddhakalkisadyojātavāmadevā aghoratatpuruṣeśānaparameśvarāḥ ṣoḍaśadalāḥ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgaśrīvatsakaustubhavanamālādikirīṭakuṇḍalakeyūrahārāṅgadaśārṅgiśaranandakapadmaveṇubarhipiñchaśeṣānantagaruḍaviṣvaksenabrahmāṇaścaturviṃśatidalāḥ keśavādicaturviṃśatyanukramam | hariśrīkṛṣṇamukundakumudākṣapuṇḍarīkākṣadhāmakaśaṅkhavarṇasarvanetrasumukhasupratīkā dvātriṃśaddalāḥ | airāvatapuṇḍarīkavāmanakumudāñjanapuṣpadantasārvabhaumasupratīkākṣāścaturaśradevatāḥ | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyāṣṭākṣarasaṃjñāvaraṇadevatāpūjā kartavyā | sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ iti nārāyaṇapūrvatāpinīyopaniṣat samāptā
